sentences.text: The Small Copper belongs to the group of insects or spiders.
In Mainz-Bingen, 126 reports were recorded over ten years, with main time from April to May and July to October.
It has been recorded eating Oregano, Sorrel, Tansy and Bitter Dock.
The Goldenrod Crab Spider is recorded as a predator.
It has been recorded pollinating Buckwheat.
It has also been recorded visiting flowers of Tansy, Heather, Daisy and Bloodwort.
